title: Anton Bruckner's birth chart
metaDescription: Anton Bruckner's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 11.8° Virgo. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The chart's headline is a trine: the Sun and Uranus within 0.1°, identity wired to disruption. A third of the circle is the tradition’s friendliest distance — same element, shared assumptions, no translation required.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: Measured rather than labelled, the Sun holds 11.8° Virgo: the second decan, whose classical sub-ruler is Saturn. An earth sign, read here in its second face.

blocks.title: Closer to the ground
blocks.text: Closer in, Mercury stands at 8.5° Libra; Venus stands at 21.9° Virgo; Mars stands at 17.4° Scorpio. The tradition reads a mind at home in argument and pattern from Mercury, taste for the substantial and the lasting from Venus, drive that moves on certainty and current from Mars.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Closest first: the Sun to Uranus, a trine with 0.1° of slack. The scheme reads trines as water finding its level: effortless, and invisible to the person living it. Behind it, Mercury trine Saturn at 0.9°, and Jupiter trine Pluto at 1.1° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. These are the day-proof angles — present at midnight, present at noon, present at the next midnight.

blocks.title: Figures in the geometry
blocks.text: Mercury opposes Pluto while both square Neptune. Two squares braced against one opposition make a t-square — the chart’s working end, where pressure keeps finding the same outlet. The Moon stands apart from every major angle the day held — the tradition reads an unaspected planet as a voice that speaks on its own schedule, unmodulated by the rest of the chart.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Of the seven planets the classical scheme judges, two sit in a sign it has an opinion about. Venus in Virgo at 21.9° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Mars in Scorpio at 17.4° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules. None of these labels is a verdict on a person; they describe how a function is situated, nothing more.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 9 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 4 earth, 2 air, 2 fire, 1 water; by modality, 4 cardinal, 3 mutable, 2 fixed. Earth weights a chart toward the material and the durable — what can be built, kept, and relied on. Uranus, Neptune and Pluto were retrograde — motion that reverses only from this vantage point, and which the old reading treats as delay used for revision.

blocks.title: The Moon is genuinely open
blocks.text: The Moon crossed from Capricorn into Aquarius during that day at the birthplace, travelling 11.9° between one midnight and the next. Without a recorded hour there is no honest way to say which side it was on, so this reading does not say. The Moon sign is a real question here, not a rounding error, and it needs a birth time nobody has published.
